method.claim: qualitative evidence and context register; not a probability model or threat intelligence product
hard_constraints: human safety floors cannot be offset by economic benefit
essential service continuity floors cannot be offset by unrelated objective gains
unknown likelihood is not zero likelihood
speculative possibility is not a probability distribution
no probability or damage magnitude is recorded without a traceable source and context

families.label: Conventional impact, fragments, blunt impact and blast
families.event_frequency_context: context_dependent; occupational, transport, industrial, civil-protection and conflict exposure differ
candidate_defensive_capabilities: safe egress and emergency medical continuity
limits: No weapon design, projectile parameters, target selection or named-system defeat analysis.

families.label: Fire, smoke, heat and thermal incidents
families.event_frequency_context: common in relevant industrial, transport, energy-storage and building contexts; frequency is site-specific
limits: A material flame test is not whole-assembly fire resistance or life-safety qualification.

families.label: Industrial chemical releases, contamination and biological emergencies
families.event_frequency_context: industrial exposure and infectious disease are context-dependent; deliberate weaponized events are a distinct and rarer scenario requiring separate evidence
candidate_defensive_capabilities: hazard detection and monitoring by competent authorities
clean/dirty zone separation under approved emergency plans
limits: No agent synthesis, dissemination, persistence optimization, exposure optimization or agent-specific operational advice.

families.label: Radiological and nuclear emergencies
families.event_frequency_context: low-frequency/context-specific; event rates must not be invented; accidental, natural and security-related initiators remain distinct
candidate_defensive_capabilities: protection of food and water supply
limits: No nuclear weapon design/effects calculation or weapon-specific protective construction advice.

families.label: PNT, communications, timing and cyber-physical service disruption
families.event_frequency_context: observed in specific sectors and regions; incident frequency depends on service, receiver, location and operational environment
limits: Receive-only defensive monitoring and safe continuity only; no jammer/spoofer construction, offensive spectrum activity or attack-path design.

families.label: Electromagnetic pulse, geomagnetic disturbance and intentional electromagnetic interference as infrastructure hazards
families.event_frequency_context: GMD event frequency differs from deliberate EMP/IEMI; assess separately. Consequence depends on network coupling, equipment and mission duration.
candidate_defensive_capabilities: manual or offline continuity where appropriate
limits: No pulse generation, waveform engineering, coupling optimization or attack simulation.

families.label: High-energy optical/laser and high-power electromagnetic exposure
families.event_frequency_context: deployment and exposure are mission-specific; do not generalize military demonstrations into ubiquitous civilian risk
candidate_defensive_capabilities: equipment-level electromagnetic compatibility and optical safety qualification
redundant data sources and post-event inspection
limits: No beam parameters, exposure optimization, aiming, range calculations or countermeasure defeat analysis.

families.label: Hypersonic and other advanced high-speed strike as a strategic infrastructure hazard
families.event_frequency_context: system capability maturity, deployment, event likelihood and local exposure are separate unknowns; do not infer one from another
limits: No missile/interceptor design, targeting, trajectory analysis or weapon employment advice.

families.label: Micrometeoroid, orbital-debris and space-environment hazards
families.event_frequency_context: small particle impacts occur during spacecraft operation; damaging risk depends on orbit, mission duration, geometry and component criticality
limits: Use space-environment models and published test evidence; no hostile orbital weapon design or engagement modelling.

families.label: Antimatter devices, microscopic black holes, strangelets, vacuum-energy devices and other exotic-physics weapon claims
families.event_frequency_context: no defensible event-frequency model; do not translate theoretical discussion into likelihood
candidate_defensive_capabilities: require independent evidence of a credible physical and engineering pathway before reassessment
retain general emergency resilience measures with ordinary multi-hazard value
limits: No device design, energy estimates, construction, triggering, handling or damage calculation. The register does not treat scientific speculation as a practical threat.

cross_cutting_priority.label: Resilient power, timing and communications
cross_cutting_priority.rationale: Supports continuity under grid outage, GMD/EMP-related disruption, cyber-physical incidents, PNT loss and compound disasters.
cross_cutting_priority.note: Use existing power resilience and EMSR owners; no new parallel control stack.

cross_cutting_priority.label: Detection, warning, safe sheltering and healthcare continuity
cross_cutting_priority.rationale: Supports fire/smoke, industrial releases, infectious disease, radiological emergency and broader disasters.
cross_cutting_priority.note: Use competent public-health, fire, building and emergency-management requirements.

cross_cutting_priority.label: Exact configuration, inspection and lifecycle provenance
cross_cutting_priority.rationale: Prevents evidence from being carried across unreviewed changes to materials, assemblies, sensors, enclosures and repairs.
cross_cutting_priority.note: Compose Mycelix manufacturing and qualification owners.

cross_cutting_priority.label: Distributed essential services and recovery capability
cross_cutting_priority.rationale: Reduces dependence on a single protective asset and helps recover after hazards that cannot be fully prevented.
